levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into a left and right halves, sharing countertop space at the middle. The left half has two Chopping Boards, the Service Counter and the Ingredient Boxes for firewood and chocolate. The right half has four Campfires, the Sink, the Plate Return, the Bin and the ingredient box for crackers and marshmallows.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of a left and right working stations connected by a corridor at the centre with the Plate Return. The left working station has at the bottom the Sink and three Pans, to the left the Ingredient Boxes for buns and beef, at the top two Chopping Boards, and at the top right the Bin. The right working station has at the bottom the Plate Return and three Deep Fryers, to the right the ingredient boxes for cheese, onions and potatoes, at the top two chopping boards, and the top left the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2 Chinese New Year)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a long horizontal table at the centre which starts with the four Plates for this level. At the top and at the bottom are two sets of three Chopping Boards and the Ingredient Boxes for oranges, grapes and peaches, but on either side a statue will alternately block off half of them. At the very left of the kitchen are the Service Counter and the Plate Return, and to the very right are the Sink and the Bin.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2 Kevin's Christmas Cracker)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of a left and right halves with a revolving Conveyor Belt as means of exchanging items. The left half has three Pots, the three cups for this level, the Sink, the Fire Extinguisher and the Ingredient Boxes for marshmallows and chocolate. The right half has two Chopping Boards, the Bin, the Plate Return, the Service Counter, the whipped cream and the milk.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2 Moon Harvest)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a left island, a right island, a top island, and a small central island. There are Lily Pads connecting the central islands with the rest, and a paved walkway connecting the right and top islands. The left island has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, one Plate and the Ingredient Box for fish. The central island has the rice. The top island has three Chopping Boards, three more plates, the Fire Extinguisher and the nori. The right island has the Bin, the Sink, two Pots and the cucumbers.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2 Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: There are three Guillotines at the top counter, which can be activated by the Button at the bottom right. There's a horizontal counter that goes across the middle, leaving a gap on the left. The Service Counter, Bin and Fire Extinguisher are at the top left, the Plate Return at the left, the Ingredient Boxes for onions, leeks, potatoes and carrots are at the bottom left, three Pots at the bottom right, and a Sink at the top right.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2 Spring Festival)
levels.overview: The kitchen is mostly L-shaped, with a Wok and set of fireplaces vertically along the left side, and another wok and fireplaces horizontalles along the bottom. Both sets of fireplaces will alternate every 30 seconds and they're placed next to Ingredient Boxes, meaning that the ingredients available will alternate depending on which woks are blocking access to them. The left vertical table has, from top to bottom: noodles, bok choy, the Sink, prawns and beef. Horizontally along the bottom are, from left to right: bok choy, noddles, beef, prawns and the Plate Return. There's an additional corridor connecting both sides which holds four Chopping Boards and the Service Counter. Also, at the top of the kitchen are the Bin and the small pan to empty woks.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2 Sun's Out, Buns Out)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of a left and right halves, with a road in the middle that can be crossed with the colourful platforms. The left side has the Sink, the Bin, three Chopping Boards, the Condiment Machine, the Fire Extinguisher, the Ingredient Box for sausages and the three Plates for this level. The right side has the buns, three Pots, the Button for the condiment machine, the Service Counter and the Plate Return.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: There are two working stations connected by a corridor where pedestrians will form conga lines, which will occasionally obstruct entrance to said stations. The left one has two Blenders, the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Ingredient Boxes for strawberries and bananas. The right working station has two Chopping Boards, the Sink and the Bin.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2 Winter Wonderland)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a table at the bottom and another table at the top which only can be accessed a half at a time, swappable at the press of a Button at the centre of the level. The top table starts with the Sink and the Bin available, and swaps to three Pots. The bottom table starts with three Chopping Boards available, and swaps to the Service Counter and the Plate Return. There's also a table to the left wall which has the Ingredient Boxes for chocolate and milk, two cups and the Fire Extinguisher. There's another table to the right wall which has two more cups, the whipped cream and the ingredient boxes for marshmallows.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: There are two ingredient boxes; fish is middle left, shrimp is middle right. You are provided four plates for the level, which all start on the center islands of the level. Four chopping stations are located at the bottom of the level; two in the left corner and two in the right corner.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! Festive Seasoning)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen has a left and right sides that both connect to the bottom. There are vertical countertops that start at the left and the middle that move horizontally and alternate between that positioning and along the middle and the right. The right of those vertical counters has Ingredient Boxes for onions, carrots and potatoes. There's water to the far left and far right of the kitchen. Along the bottom horizontal corridor, there's a table at the top with the Bin at the middle and two Plates, and another one at the bottom with the Sink, the Plate Return and the Service Counter.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked! The Lost Morsel)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is split in half by a large Conveyor Belt section placed in the middle. The upper kitchen has a middle counter with 2 Burners, and all of the Ingredient boxes, except for the one with Rice. Above that middle section is a large Countertop, on it is a Pot, a Pan and two Plates. There is a Trash Bin on the left side, a Plate Return on the left and the Service Counter on the right. The lower section is nearly identical to the upper one but is flipped 180 degrees and has a Rice Ingredient Box and a Sink instead of the boxes mentioned above, there is a Fire Extinguisher and one of the burners is turned into a Chopping Board, making this the second kitchen to only have 3 Burners but 4 Cookware. Two Countertops near the Conveyor move back and forth, pushing Chefs off and disrupting them.

levels.title: 1-1 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Countertop that needs to be walked around
levels.overview: The kitchen has a fairly simple layout, in the top-left corner is an Onion ingredient box, in the top-right is a burner with a pot on it, to the right is a sink, there is a Serving Counter alongside the Plate Return in the lower-right corner and Chopping Boards at the bottom. There are two plates in the lower-right corner of the kitchen. Before the Chefs serve their first dish, prompts will appear teaching them how to chop, cook in a pot and serve. Additionally, another tutorial prompt will appear teaching chefs how to wash dishes.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen has the Service Counter and Plate Return to the very right, and the Ingredient Boxes for bananas and chocolate to the very left. Then at the centre left there are 4 Campfires and at the middle right there's a rectangular table with 4 Chopping Boards and the ingredient boxes for marshmallows and firewood to the left. Then, on the outer ring of the kitchen, at the top right there are crackers, at the bottom right the Bin, and at the bottom left the Sink.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen comprises mostly a central lower area that connects to the left with some stairs, and a raised platform to the right that can be accessed by being launched by the cannon on the left. The right area has the Service Counter and the Plate Return. The left area has the Sink, the Cannon and the Button for the cannon. The central area has a U-shaped countertop table at the bottom with three Chopping Boards, the Bin to the left and the Fire Extinguisher to the right. At the centre of the area there are the Ingredient Boxes for dough, cheese and tomatoes. At the top of the central area are three Ovens and some countertop space.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2 Chinese New Year)
levels.overview: There are four possible fire sources on each of the corners of the kitchen and two Woks to use on them. The fires will always light up in a diagonal every 20 seconds. At the very top of the kitchen are the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Bin. At the very bottom are the Sink and the small pan to empty the woks. At the centre there's a ring of countertops which start with a Plate at each corner, has two Chopping Boards to the left and another two to the right, and below it are the Ingredient Boxes for noodles, beef, prawns and bok choy.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2 Kevin's Christmas Cracker)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of a left and right platforms connected with a bridge either at the top or at the bottom that will swap by sinking every ~36 seconds. The left platform has at the bottom the Sink and the Bin; to the left three Plates with the Ingredient Boxes for flour and eggs on either side; and at the top three Mixers. The right platform has at the bottom the Plate Return and Service Counter; to the right three Chopping Boards with dried fruit and oranges on either side; and at the top three Ovens and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2 Moon Harvest)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a left island, a right island, and a central island split in two with shared countertops. Paths made up of a mixture of Lily Pads and solid rocks connect all the islands. The left island has two Pots and the Ingredient Boxes for grapes, nori and oranges. The right island has the Plate Return, two Plates and the boxes for rice and peaches. The central island has the Fire Extinguisher at the shared middle countertop; then to the left the Sink, the cucumbers, the Bin and the Service Counter; and to the right three Chopping Boards and two more plates.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2 Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into a small section upstairs at the top right, and downstairs everywhere else. There are two Ovens at the top left and bottom right, which can be heated up to speed up cooking by the Furnace at the right side of the upstairs working area. The furnace can be heated up by dumping in a bucket of coal, which is located at the bottom next to two ovens. Upstairs has the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Bin at the top, two Chopping Boards at the bottom left and the Sink at the bottom right. Downstairs has the Fire Extinguisher at the bottom right and, along the left wall, the Ingredient Boxes for carrots, potatoes, beef and chicken.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2 Spring Festival)
levels.overview: The kitchen is a long rectangle with short vertical tables that form an S winding path. Both of these short tables can be moved between a left and right positions at the push of either Button to the far left or far right of the kitchen. Along the top side of the kitchen are, from left to right: the Service Counter, the Plate Return, two Chopping Boards, a Pot and the Ingredient Box for rice. The leftmost vertical table will start off blocking the plate return and can alternately block the rice. This left vertical table has fish and nori. Along the bottom of the kitchen are: a Plate, the box for oranges, two more chopping boards, another pot, the Sink and the Bin. The rightmost vertical table will start blocking the oranges and alternate with blocking the sink. Additionally, to the very left of the kitchen are three more plates and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2 Sun's Out, Buns Out)
levels.overview: The kitchen has left and right halves with a constant stream of moving platforms at the top and bottom connecting them. These platforms have some space for chefs to stand on, some countertops and a Service Counter. The left half has three Chopping Boards, the Drinks Machine, the three Glasses, the Ingredient Box for milk and the three removable parts of the Blenders. The right half has the Sink, the Bin, the Button for the drinks machine, the three bases of the blenders and the boxes for chocolate, vanilla and ice.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: The kitchen in this level is horizontal and surrounded by water, where Ingredient Boxes and Chopping Boards will sink and resurface at different places every ~35 seconds. The Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Bin are at the leftmost side of the platform, and the two Blenders and the Sink are at the middle.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2 Winter Wonderland)
levels.overview: The waves of unbread will attack the Service Barriers to the left, top and right sides of the kitchen. To the top left of the kitchen are the Bin, the Plate Return, an Oven and the Ingredient Box for flour. To the top right are the eggs, another oven and the Sink. To the bottom right are two Chopping Boards. To the bottom centre two Mixers, two additional bowls, dried fruit and oranges. To the bottom left are another two chopping boards and the Fire Extinguisher. At the middle of the level there are some countertops and the two Plates for this level.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: There are three ingredient boxes in the middle of the kitchen. You are provided four plates for the level; two plates start on the top middle counter and two more plates on the bottom counter. Three chopping stations are located at the top left of the kitchen. The serving window and plate return are on the top right of the kitchen. The stove is located on the bottom right and the bin is in the bottom middle.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! Festive Seasoning)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: This level is split into a right and left halves, with vertical counters to the left of the kitchen, the middle and the right. From these vertical tables there are 2-block long counters going into each side that will occasionally shift, granting or limiting access to kitchen utensils on each side. There are two Chopping Boards and two Pots along the middle counter, with the left side starting out with access to the chopping boards and the right side to the pots. Then, each working area is a mirror of each other, and they both include: the Plate Return, the Service Counter and the Bin at the top; the Ingredient Boxes on the outer wall; a Plate on counters towards the middle; and the Sink at the bottom. Additionally, the left side has the Flamethrower at the bottom of the kitchen.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked! The Lost Morsel)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is split into four sections; three of which are always available and can be changed depending on the middle Countertop's position. Said Countertop has 2 Pans on Burners; one is reachable, one isn't. There is a hole in the Countertop lot that allows passing between the bottom and top sections. The vertical counter top has two buttons which both move the section back and forth upon pressing. The top-left section has all of the Ingredient boxes and the Trash Bin, the bottom-left has a Chopping Board, the Service Counter, the Plate Return and two Plates. The bottom-right has another Chopping Board and the top right has a Fire Extinguisher and the Sink.

levels.title: 1-2 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is split into two halves separated by a crosswalk on which pedestrians walk from both sides, interrupting the chefs. On the right side are two Ingredient boxes; one with Onions and the other one with Tomatoes. There is a countertop to the left on which chefs can pass ingredients. There is a Serving Counter and the Plate Return on the right, and a Trash Bin at the top. On the left side is the Sink, Cooking Pots and Chopping Boards. There are two Plates in this kitchen.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen is shaped like a ring with (not fully connected) countertops on an inner and outer circles. The Service Counter and the Plate Return are at the very right, and the Sink and the Bin are at the very left. Then on each outer corner there's a Chopping Board. On the middle bottom of the inner circle there are two Ovens, and on the top of the outer circle there are two more. There's an Ingredient Box for olives on the middle top of the inner circle and one for tomatoes on the bottom of the outer circle. Next to the tomatoes there's a Fire Extinguisher. There will be a Backpack for dough to the left side and one for cheese to the right side.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: This level has two chopping areas at the top left and top right, which connect to the lower half of the kitchen via a narrow corridor at the centre. Pedestrians will walk through this corridor and horizontally across the kitchen. The top left corner has the Ingredient Boxes for chicken and buns, two Chopping Boards, the Plate Return and the Bin. The top right corner has the ingredient boxes for potatoes, cheese and onions, another two chopping boards and the Service Counter. At the centre of the lower half is a horizontal table where the four trays for this level start at. Along the bottom half walls there's countertops in a U-shape. Starting at the right and going clockwise are the Sink, three Deep Fryers, three Pans and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2 Chinese New Year)
levels.overview: At the centre of the kitchen there's a large ring of countertops with kitchen utensils, and some obstacles at the middle of said ring which hinder throwing ingredients across. During the level, a Dancing Dragon will circle around the kitchen clockwise or counterclockwise, pushing chefs in front of it and blocking access to kitchen utensils. At the bottom left of the central countertops are three Mixers, at the top left three Chopping Boards, at the top right three Steamers, and at the bottom right the Ingredient Boxes for flour, carrots, beef and prawns. At the very bottom of the kitchen are the Service Counter and the Plate Return, at the very left the Fire Extinguisher, and at the very top the Sink and the Bin.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2 Kevin's Christmas Cracker)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a top and bottom halves that share countertops and the whipped cream. Each side has a pool of water towards the centre and they also both share a vertical table with two Pots that will swap sides every ~34 seconds. The bottom half has to the left the Service Counter, the Plate Return and two cups; and to the right two Chopping Boards. The top half has to the left the Ingredient Boxes for milk, chocolate and marshmallows; and to the right the Bin, the Fire Extinguisher, the Sink and another two cups.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2 Moon Harvest)
levels.overview: This kitchen splits chefs between a left and right sides, with Conveyor Belts at the middle bottom. The conveyor belts will bring items into a Bin, unless a Button on either side is pressed, which will allow items into their section for a few seconds. It will blink when the timer is about to run out. Each side also has a top section that connects with stairs to the bottom. Both of the top sides can throw ingredients across. The top left section has the Service Counter, the Fire Extinguisher, a Mixer, a bin and the three Plates. The bottom left section has the Sink, two more mixers, a button and the Ingredient Boxes for chocolate, egg and flour. The top right section has three Ovens and the Plate Return. The bottom right section has two Chopping Boards, a button and the boxes for strawberries and watermelons.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2 Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into a top and bottom halves connected with shared counters and a Lever. This lever at the centre of the level will alternate which half has access to the tables on the right. The top half has Ingredient Boxes for potatoes, carrots and broccoli, while the bottom half has two Chopping Boards and the Plate Return. The top half has two more ingredient boxes for beef and chicken, three Ovens, the Sink, the Bin and the Fire Extinguisher. The bottom half has the Service Counter to the left and is where the four Plates start at.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2 Spring Festival)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a C-shaped corridor for the two Woks with fireplaces at each corner. The fires will swap every 30 seconds, but will sometimes only change one of the two places, and may have both fires at the top. At the centre of this C are some obstacles that prevent movement or throwing, and to the left of that the Ingredient Box for bok choy and a Plate, and to the right beef and a second plate. At the very top of the kitchen are the Plate Return, the Service Counter and two Chopping Boards. Along the very bottom of the kitchen are two more chopping boards, the small pan to empty woks, the Sink and the Bin. To the far left are prawns and a third dish, and to the far right are noodles and the fourth dish.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2 Sun's Out, Buns Out)
levels.obstacles: Moving platforms, control switch, isolated chefs, fireworks
levels.overview: This level takes place in a pool, with all the countertops at the outer edge. Chefs will be standing on a maneuverable platform with a control switch at its centre, and split with a horizontal countertop. Throughout the level, Fireworks will randomly land onto the platform, acting like fires that need to be put out in order to go across them. The kitchen utensils around the outer ring are: the Service Counter and the Plate Return at the middle top; three Plates at the top right; the Fire Extinguisher and two Chopping Boards to the right; another two chopping boards at the bottom right; the Bin and the Sink at the bottom centre; another fire extinguisher to the left; and along the top left corner the Ingredient Boxes for tomatoes, lettuce, cucumbers, corn and onions.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: Chefs will be split between a left and right working stations. The left station has two Pans, the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Fire Extinguisher, a Bin, the three Plates for this level and the Ingredient Boxes for beef and cheese. The right side has two Chopping Boards, a Bin, the Water Gun and the ingredient boxes for buns, lettuce and tomatoes.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2 Winter Wonderland)
levels.overview: There's an upper level, which connects to the lower one by two sets of stairs either to the right or left of the room. There are two Backpacks, the one for oranges at the upper level and the one for dried fruit at the lower one. At the upper level there's the Service Counter, Plate Return and four Mixers. At the bottom level are four Ovens, four Plates, three Chopping Boards, the Sink, the Bin, the Fire Extinguisher and the Ingredient Boxes for eggs and flour.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: There are four ingredient boxes; shrimp, nori, and rice are middle left, cucumber is middle right. You are provided four plates for the level; two plates start on the island to the left and another two on the right counter. Three chopping stations are located at the top left of the kitchen. The serving window is at the bottom left and the plate return and sink are on the bottom right of the kitchen. The stove is located on the top right and the bin is in the bottom middle.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! Festive Seasoning)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The layout of this kitchen consists of narrow labyrinthine corridors made up of a mix of countertops and conveyor belts. Almost all of the surfaces start out filled with ingredients, but no more will spawn throughout the level. There are three Pots and two Chopping Boards scattered throughout the kitchen. The Service Counter, the Plate Return and three Plates are at the top left corner, the Bin to the top right, and the Sink at the bottom right.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked! The Lost Morsel)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Ingredient Dispensers that dispense ingredients randomly, Conveyor Belts
levels.overview: The kitchen is set around a giant totem with 8 Pots on Burners set in a grid pattern, with Countertops in between them. There are 3 Chopping Boards alongside more Countertops at the bottom. There is a Plate Return and the Service Counter top middle, then a Fire Extinguisher and the Sink on the left, while 3 Plates are sitting on the right. Ingredients are sent on side Conveyor Belts by Aztec totem-like Ingredient Dispensers. There is no guarantee that the needed Soup Ingredients will match the Orders.

levels.title: 1-3 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is split into two halves, the right half has a Serving Counter, the Plate Return and Ingredient boxes while the left has Chopping Stations and Pots with Burners. The middle countertops slide back and forth as the Ship sways in opposite directions. There is no Sink in this kitchen.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a left and right halves that share countertops at the middle. At the very left there's the Service Counter, the Plate Return, two Chopping Boards and the Fire Extinguisher. At the very right there's the Sink, the Bin and the Ingredient Boxes for (from top to bottom) flour, eggs, chocolate and blueberries. Then there are two horizontal tables at the top and bottom that will periodically move left and right. The top one starts at the left side and has three Mixers, whereas the bottom one starts at the right and has three Pans.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen is mostly a rectangle shaped outer countertop table with the kitchen utensils placed along. At the top centre is the Condiment Machine with some haystacks that make a narrow corridor towards it. Starting from the condiment machine and going clockwise are the Fire Extinguisher and Ingredient Box for sausages at the top right; the Sink and Bin to the right; three Pots, three Plates, the Button for the condiment machine and three Chopping Boards to the bottom; the Plate Return and the Service Counter to the left; and the ingredient box for buns to the top left.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! 2 Chinese New Year)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a bottom left area and a top right area connected by a narrow bridge. Each side has two fire places in a diagonal and a Wok. Both fires will swap places every 30 seconds. The bottom left working station has the Sink and the Bin at the bottom, and at the top are two Plates and the Ingredient Boxes for beef, bok choy, noodles and prawns. The top right working station has at the bottom three Chopping Boards and another two plates, and at the top the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the small pan to empty the woks.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! 2 Kevin's Christmas Cracker)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of two long horizontal tables and a short vertical one connecting them both. This small vertical separation will move throughout the level along the tables to either the right, middle or left. It is possible to walk around the tables. The table at the top has, from left to right, three Ovens, two Plates, the Plate Return, the Ingredient Boxes for oranges and eggs, the Fire Extinguisher and the Service Counter. The table at the bottom has the Sink, the boxes for flour and dried fruit, the Bin, two more plates and three Mixers.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! 2 Moon Harvest)
levels.obstacles: Lily pads, isolated chefs, conveyor belts
levels.overview: This kitchen splits chefs in a top and bottom halves, which can pass ingredients along through Conveyor Belts that end up in Bins. The top half has a right and left platforms connected by 2x3 Lily Pads, with one Mixer on either side, two Chopping Boards to the left, and Ingredient Boxes for chocolate to the left, and for flour, strawberries, peaches, watermelons and oranges to the right. The bottom half has a left platform, a middle platform and a right platform connected with lily pads. The left platform has the Sink, two Plates, a chopping board and the box for grapes. The middle platform has two Ovens and the Fire Extinguisher. The right platform has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, two more plates and the box for eggs.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! 2 Spring Festival)
levels.overview: At the very centre of the kitchen there's a cleared corridor that the Dancing Dragon will occasionally cross. Right above it there's a table with two Pots and the three Plates for this level. Right below it is another table with three Chopping Boards. Along the very top of the kitchen are some countertops with the Fire Extinguisher, the Ingredient Boxes for grapes, peaches and cucumber, the Bin, the Sink and then boxes for oranges and fish. Along the very bottom of the kitchen are more countertops with the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the ingredient boxes for rice and nori.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! 2 Sun's Out, Buns Out)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into a top and bottom halves. At the middle of the bottom half there's a Pressure Plate that will change the condiment of the condiment machine as well as launch three Fireworks at random places in the kitchen. The top half has a Fire Extinguisher, the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Ingredient Box for sausages, the Condiment Machine and two Chopping Boards. The bottom half has the Bin, a Pan, two Pots, another fire extinguisher, three Plates, the boxes for onions and buns, and the Sink.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: The kitchen is shaped like an H. On the top right and left corners there are a Service Counter and two Chopping Boards, with a moving counter that will move left to right alternately blocking either them. This counter has the Ingredient Boxes for pineapples, bananas, strawberries and watermelons. At the bottom right and left there's a Blender, a Plate Return and a Bin each. The Water Gun starts at the bottom left.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! 2 Winter Wonderland)
levels.overview: The kitchen has the shape of an inverted U, with a small section locked behind two Unlockable Gates to the left and to the right, which cost 250 coins each (in Overcooked! 2, the right one costs only 150 coins). The waves of unbread will attack the Service Barriers to the left, top left, top right and right sides of the kitchen. The left side of the kitchen has the Ingredient Boxes for potatoes, broccoli, carrots, chicken and beef, as well as the Bin. The right side has two Chopping Boards and the Fire Extinguisher. At the top are three Ovens, two Plates, the Sink and the Plate Return. Inside the locked area are one Chopping Board and two more plates.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: There are four ingredient boxes for shrimp, nori, cucumber, and rice on top left side. You are provided with four plates which all start out in the center of the kitchen. Two chopping stations are located at the top right of the kitchen. The service window and plate return are at the bottom middle. The sink and bin are on the middle left of the kitchen. There are three stoves located on the middle right and bottom right of the kitchen. There are two conveyor belts going horizontally across the top and bottom of the kitchen.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! Festive Seasoning)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into four quadrants with a central cross-shaped table that will occasionally rotate clockwise, splitting the kitchen either vertically or horizontally. This is telegraphed by flaring of the lantern in the middle. The top left quadrant has the Ingredient Boxes for beef and potatoes, one Pot and one Bin. The top right quadrant has a Chopping Board, the Fire Extinguisher and the Sink. The bottom right quadrant has the boxes for onions and carrots and a pot. The bottom left quadrant has a chopping board, two Plates, the Service Counter and the Plate Return.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked! The Lost Morsel)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is set at night. The kitchen is made up of two sectors, the cooking sector (on the right), and the ingredient sector (on the left). The Ingredient sector has all of the Ingredient Boxes and two Chopping Boards. There is a Trash Bin below all of the ingredient boxes. The cooking sector has 4 Burners on which Cookware is placed upon; Pots and Pans. There is a Fire Extinguisher just to the left of the upmost Burner, a Service Counter, Trash Bin and the Plate Return on the right, and four Plates placed on the Countertops of this section. To traverse between the two sections, chefs must use tight corridors above and below the two sections through which fireballs are fired from cannons. A Sink is placed in the middle of the top corridor, requiring chefs to wash plates while in danger. Incoming fireballs can be dodged by hiding into one of the 3 hiding spots in the corridors made up of revomed Countertops. This kitchen contains Rats which steal Ingredients from the chefs, preventing them from handing over them using the corner Countertops. In Overcooked!, the rats would only come out of the Countertop placed in the upper right corner of the kitchen. In Overcooked: All You Can Eat, the rats also spawn and come out of the upper right corner, but not from the table anymore, simply the brick wall. Another rat spawnpoint is added in that game in the bottom left of the kitchen.

levels.title: 1-4 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: Upon starting, the player gets a visual tutorial on how to make a Meat Burger. The kitchen is made of two sectors connected by a small 1x3 corridor. On the left side are 5 Plates, the most out of any level in the Overcooked! Series tied with 1-6 (Overcooked! 2). There is a Plate Return, a Serving Counter, 4 Pans on Burners and some Countertops. On the left side are the Ingredient boxes, the Sink, the Trash Bin and the Chopping Stations.

levels.title: 1-5 (Overcooked! 2 Chinese New Year)
levels.overview: The kitchen is separated into a left and right halves, connected and surrounded by Conveyor Belts that end in Bins. The left working area has three Mixers, the Sink and the Plate Return. It has access to prawns on the upper conveyor belt, and beef on the lower one. The right working area has three Steamers, two Chopping Boards, the Service Counter, the three Plates and the Fire Extinguisher. It has access to flour on the upper conveyor belt, and carrots on the lower one.

levels.title: 1-5 (Overcooked! 2 Kevin's Christmas Cracker)
levels.obstacles: Moving tables, gusts of wind, bottleneck
levels.overview: The kitchen has a left and right halves connected by a narrow bridge. At the bottom left and top right are two sets of tables that will alternate every ~30 seconds. To start with, the top right will start with three Chopping Boards and the bottom left with the Ingredient Boxes for flour, eggs, dried fruit, oranges and chocolate. Additionally, the top right always has access to the Plate Return and the bottom left always has access to the Bin. At the top left are L-shaped countertops with the Sink, two Plates, two Ovens and two Pans. At the bottom right are another L-shaped countertops with the Service Counter, the Fire Extinguisher, two Mixers and two more plates.

levels.title: 1-5 (Overcooked! 2 Moon Harvest)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of four horizontal tables with three platforms between them, and Lily Pads connecting the sides. There are also two 2x2 lily pads along the top and bottom platforms, and 4x2 lily pads in the middle one. The top table has, from left to right: the Service Counter, the Plate Return, two Ovens, the Ingredient Boxes for flour, eggs and strawberries, and the Fire Extinguisher. The middle top table has a Pot and two Chopping Boards with a Plate to either side. The middle bottom table has another pot and two more plates flanking the ingredient boxes for chocolate, cucumber, eggs and fish. The bottom table has nori, two Mixers, the Sink and the Bin.

levels.title: 1-5 (Overcooked! 2 Spring Festival)
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between a left and right halves, connected by a middle platform. This middle platform, in turn, has a top and bottom halves, and only one of these halves can be accessed at a time, swapping it at the press of a Button. Occasionally a Dancing Dragon may cross the kitchen, preventing the pressing of the button while it's still on the middle platform. At the left half of the kitchen the four Plates start at the left countertops, and at the bottom are the Service Counter, the Plate Return and a button. At the right half of the kitchen are, along the top side, the Bin, the Sink and a button. At the top half of the middle platform there are four Mixers on one side, and on the other side four Chopping Boards, the Fire Extinguisher and the flour. At the bottom half of the middle platform there are three Steamers on one side and on the other the Ingredient Boxes for beef, fish and carrots.

levels.title: 1-5 (Overcooked! 2 Sun's Out, Buns Out)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided on a left and right halves and they will pass Ingredient Boxes above and below them, as well as Bins and Service Counters. The right half only has access to sausages, bins and service counters, whereas the left half can pick up milk, chocolate, vanilla and also has bins and service counters. The left half has a Fire Extinguisher, a Chopping Board, three Glasses, two Pots, the Condiment Machine, the Drinks Machine and the Plate Return for glasses. It shares with the right half a second chopping board and the boxes for buns and ice. The right half has the Plate Return for plates, another fire extinguisher, a third chopping board, the button for both machines, two Mixers and three Plates.

levels.title: 1-5 (Overcooked! 2 Winter Wonderland)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of a left and right islands, where chefs can get launched with a Cannon from left to right, and go through a portal from the right back to the left side. The landing area for the cannon is on a set of moving platforms with patches of water, so chefs can get launched into a hazard, which would make them respawn as well as anything they were holding, removing any prepared ingredients from them. The left island has three Chopping Boards at the top and three Mixers at the bottom. Along the right wall are the Fire Extinguisher, the Ingredient Boxes for oranges and dried fruit, the Bin, and then the boxes for strawberries and chocolate. Along the left wall are the cannon, the Button for the cannon, the Plate Return, the flour and the eggs. The right island has two Ovens and two Plates at the top, and two Pans and two more plates at the bottom. Then to the left is the landing area of moving pieces of land, and to the right are the Service Counter, the portal and the Sink.

levels.title: 1-5 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between two hot air balloons in this level, a large one on the left and a small one on the right. The chefs can switch between the balloons in the middle of the level. The large balloon is divided at the start of the level, with the two burners with pans at the top and two burners with pots at the bottom. On the left is the bin and to the right of that are three chopping stations. The chopping stations slide up and down throughout the level. The two plates for the level start out to their right. On the small balloon there is the sink at the top. On the right are the two ingredient boxes and the plate return. At the bottom is the service window.

levels.title: 1-5 (Overcooked! Festive Seasoning)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: Chefs are split between a left and right working stations, with conveyor belts in between them. There's a conveyor belt at the bottom of the kitchen going from right to left and ending up on a Bin. There's another conveyor belt that starts at the top left and ends up converging into the previous conveyor belt. The right working station has the Fire Extinguisher, two Flamethrowers, all the Ingredient Boxes, the Plate Return, the Sink and a bin. The left working station has the Service Counter, two [[Chopping Boards and three Plates.

levels.title: 1-5 (Overcooked! The Lost Morsel)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided in half by a middle Countertop. The left side has two Pots on Burners, while the right side has two Chopping Boards, all easily accessible. There are 4 chambers blocked by totems that lower by standing on Pressure Plates. Each one is lowered by a button on the opposite of the kitchen. Each of the chambers has one thing inside: *The lower left has the Mushroom Ingredient Box *The upper left has the Onion Ingredient Box *The upper right has the Tomato Ingredient Box *The lower left has the Sink The Countertop between the upper chambers has 3 Plates, the upper sections have Trash Bins and a Fire Extinguisher is present on the left. The Service Counter and the Plate Return are on the left.

levels.title: 1-5 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: 1 Block wide pathway everywhere except near Serving Counter
levels.overview: This kitchen features an oval corridor in which all of the appliances lie. There are Ingredient boxes placed in the upper-left corner, 2 Chopping Stations (1 in Singleplayer mode of Overcooked!) in the lower-left corner, 3 Pots and Burners in the lower-right corner and a Sink in the upper-right corner.

levels.title: 1-6 (Overcooked! 2 Chinese New Year)
levels.overview: There's an inner ring of countertops that encase some chefs. Two Dancing Dragons will come out at 3:30 remaining time and start circling this inner ring, occasionally stopping and leaving the right and left sides accessible. The inner ring has at the top three Steamers and the Ingredient Boxes for flour and oranges; to the right one Chopping Board and two Plates; at the bottom the Sink and Plate Return; and to the left another chopping board and a third plate. At the very top of the kitchen is the Service Counter. Along the outer walls, to the right are the Bin and the fish; at the bottom the prawns, peaches, three Mixers, grapes and beef; and to the left the carrots and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 1-6 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview:
There are two kitchens in this level, a balloon and a building. After 2 minutes and 20 seconds, the balloon will crash into the sushi building for the second part. The balloon has everything in a square. On the top is the service window and the plate return. On the left are two chopping stations and a plate. On the bottom are two plates, the sink, and the bin. On the right are the three ingredient boxes. While in the balloon, fire will be randomly shot from the flame in the middle of the balloon to a random location within the balloon. The projectiles turn into flames upon hitting the ground, and they will slowly dissipate. The Fire Extinguisher can speed this up. The flames cannot be moved through.
Once the balloon starts to fall out of the sky, the items on the left and right side of the balloon will slide around. After the crash, the layout of the balloon is in the center of the building. The differences are along the edges of the kitchen.
At the top middle is the service window, two more plates and another bin to the left.
On the top left is a conveyor belt with fish.
On the bottom left is a conveyor belt with rice.
At the bottom middle are two new chopping stations. In the bottom right is another trash, a fire extinguisher, and a sink.
On the right are two stoves with pots.
And at the top right is a conveyor belt with nori.

levels.title: 1-6 (Overcooked! Festive Seasoning)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of a narrow corridor with countertops along the four sides, and conveyor belts looping clockwise in the middle. The corridor widens a bit by the Service Counter and Plate Return at the top left, and there's an indentation and the top middle, otherwise chefs cannot pass each other. On the countertops starting from the top and going clockwise there are: at the top one Chopping Board, the Ingredient Box for potatoes and a Flamethrower; to the right the Sink and the Fire Extinguisher; at the bottom another chopping board, boxes for turkey and carrots, another flamethrower and the Bin; to the left three Plates.

levels.title: 1-6 (Overcooked! The Lost Morsel)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Moving Oven, Chopping Board and Ingredient Boxes.
levels.overview: The last kitchen in the Lost Morsel has four quadrants. The kitchen has a Service Counter, Oven and a Trash Bin in the top-right corner, the top-left corner has the Plate Return, the Chopping Board another Trash Bin and the Fire Extinguisher, the bottom-left corner has a Sink and the Ingredient Boxes (all except for the one with Dough), and the bottom-right doesn't have anything. 2 Plates and the Dough Ingredient Box are placed on the vertical Countertops that split the kitchen. The four quadrants have empty spaces with pits that give a Time Penalty if fallen into, which the Chopping Board, the Oven and Ingredient boxes shuffle around. After the first change, the Chopping Board lands in the top-right corner (at the rightmost hole), and the Oven lands in the bottom-right corner (the lowest hole). After the second change, the four Ingredient boxes travel to the opposite side of the kitchen, with only the Dough box not moving. After the fourth change, the Chopping Board goes to the lower-left corner, and the Oven goes to the top-right corner. After another change the positions revert to their starting position.

levels.title: 1-6 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Consistent Earthquake, Raising Platform on the right side of the kitchen
levels.overview: This kitchen has a constant earthquake that splits the right and left sides of the kitchen. The right side is elevated, meaning, all chefs can drop down at any moment. On the left side are Ingredient boxes with Tomatoes, Lettuce and Beef, Chopping Stations, the Sink, a Pan and the Trash Bin. On the left side are 3 Plates, 3 Pans, the Serving Counter, the Bun Ingredient Box and the Plate Return.

levels.title: 1-7 (Overcooked! 2 Chinese New Year)
levels.overview: There are two Woks within two sets of fireplaces placed horizontally along the middle of the kitchen. Right between the paths of the two woks there are countertops with four Chopping Boards. Above the upper path there are Ingredient Boxes for beef, prawns and oranges, as well as two Plates. Below the lower path are two more plates, the oranges and the grapes. At the top right of the kitchen are the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the bok choy. At the bottom left of the kitchen are the noodles, the Sink, the Bin and the small pan to empty the woks.

levels.title: 1-7 (Overcooked! Festive Seasoning)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between a top and bottom halves with a conveyor belt that goes from left to right and ends on a Bin, with the middle left part surrounded by water chefs can fall into. Uncooked turkeys will periodically spawn from the left of this conveyor belt. Each side has, to their left side, a conveyor belt that converges into the middle one. Each side has the same layout consisting of a Chopping Board, a Flamethrower and an Ingredient Box to the left, and then to the right a Bin, a Plate, a Sink, a Plate Return and a Service Counter. The bottom side has potatoes, while the top side has carrots and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 1-8 (Overcooked! Festive Seasoning)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is split in two sides and a middle section that has the moving center bridge. On both sides is a Bin. The left side has the Plates, the Service Counter with the Plate Return next to it, the Sink and four Chopping Boards split up between the top and bottom Countertops. The right side has a Pot each on the top, middle and bottom countertops, the Ingredient Boxes and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 2-1 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a raised area at the top centre, connected by stairs to the right and can be jumped down towards the left. On this raised area there are three Pans at the top and a Sink at the bottom. Downstairs, there are Ingredient Boxes for bacon and sausages at the top right and for eggs and beans at the top left. The Service Counter is at the very left, the Fire Extinguisher at the bottom left, the Bin at the bottom right, four Chopping Boards at the centre and the Plate Return at the middle of them.

levels.title: 2-1 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of a left and right platforms that are connected by another moving platform on the bottom part, activated by Buttons on either side. This moving platform consists of two 2x2 countertops with a 1x2 space for chefs to stand on in the middle. There are haystacks between both sides that block throwing. Each the left and right sides consist of a small open space with countertops and kitchen utensils on the outer edge. The left area has, starting from the bottom left and going clockwise: the Plate Return, a button, the Service Counter, three Plates, three Mixers, the Sink and the Ingredient Boxes for flour and eggs. The right area has the ingredient box for raspberries, three Deep Fryers, the Fire Extinguisher, three Chopping Boards, a button and the Bin.

levels.title: 2-1 (Overcooked! 2 Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into a left and right halves, with bridges that will alternate which side has access to the middle countertops by Levers on either side. The left half has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Ingredient Boxes for chicken, beef and mushrooms, two Chopping Boards and three Pans. The right half has three Pots, the ingredient boxes for tortillas and rice, the Fire Extinguisher, the Sink andthe Bin.

levels.title: 2-1 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: This level consists of a central lower area with two Chopping Boards that connects through sets of stairs towards a top, right and left areas. At the top are the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Bin, the Water Gun, the Bellows, the two Plates for this level and the Ingredient Box for chicken. The right area has a Barbecue and the boxes for beef and tomatoes. The left area has another Barbecue and the boxes for mushrooms and pineapples.

levels.title: 2-1 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: There are two floating rafts in this level. The top raft has two chopping stations at its top. The bottom raft has much more. On the right are two plates and the bin. On the left are two more plates and the fire extinguisher. Along the bottom, from left to right, are a deep fryer, the chicken ingredient box, the service window, the plate return, the potato ingredient box, and a second fryer.

levels.title: 2-1 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Moving Trucks, 5 second penalty for falling off
levels.overview: The kitchen is set up on a highway on two trucks, with them driving closer and further from each other, allowing to pass between them if they are driving like said formerly. The lower truck has two Chopping Stations, Ingredient boxes and the Trash Bin. There is also a Fire Extinguisher. The upper truck has an Ingredient box with Buns, three Plates, the Service Counter, the Plate Return and 3 Pans on Burners. There is no Sink in this kitchen.

levels.title: 2-2 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: At the bottom left there's a sunken area connected with stairs to the top left and bottom right sides, and it holds four Chopping Boards. The Service Counter and the Plate Return are at the top left. There are three Pans at the top right. At the middle right there are Ingredient Boxes for eggs and beans. The Sink, the Bin and the Fire Extinguisher are at the bottom right. The backpacks hold the bacon and sausages.

levels.title: 2-2 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of a horizontal table with kitchen utensils at the top, another at the centre and one more at the bottom. Between the middle and top tables there's a platform that covers half the area with low walls to its right and left, which will alternate between being on the left and right halves every 35 seconds. While on the platform you still have access to the kitchen utensils to the top and bottom, but the only exit is 1 block wide to either the bottom left or right. Along the top table are, from left to right: the Button for the drinks machine, three Pans, two Deep Fryers, the Ingredient Boxes for cheese, potatoes, onions, beef and buns, and the Drinks Machine. On the right half of the middle table are the Fire Extinguisher and three Chopping Boards. On the bottom table are the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Bin and the Sink.

levels.title: 2-2 (Overcooked! 2 Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into four quadrants, where the top and bottom halves are split with shared countertops, and the right and left halves can be connected with bridges that will alternate between connecting the top or the bottom quadrants at the pull of a Lever. The top left quadrant has three Ovens and the Ingredient Boxes for flour and eggs. The top right quadrant has the Service Counter, two Guillotines, a button for said guillotines, a lever and the Fire Extinguisher. The bottom right quadrant has the Plate Return, the Bin and the ingredient boxes for cherries, blackberries and apples. The bottom left quadrant has three Mixers, the Sink and a lever.

levels.title: 2-2 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: Your chefs will be aboard a raft that goes along a river, passing by Ingredient Boxes and Service Counters. The raft itself is split into two small areas separated by a horizontal counter where both share two Chopping Boards and the control stick. The upper half has a Barbecue, the Bellows and the Bin, and the lower half has another barbecue, the Plate Return and the Fire Extinguisher. Above the river there will be boxes of chicken, pineapples and tomatoes. Below the river there will be boxes for beef, mushrooms and tomatoes. Service Counters will alternate sides, so after passing one above the river the following will be below it, and so on.

levels.title: 2-2 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: There are three hot air balloons in this level, a large one on the right and two small ones to the left in a line. The leftmost balloon has the Service Counter on the far left. On the bottom of the balloon is the beef and noodles ingredient boxes. The middle balloon has the shrimp and fish ingredient boxes. On the top are two Chopping Boards. This balloon moves up and down the level, making it difficult to get to and from the other balloons. The right balloon is configured in a square. The top has a stove with a pot and a plate. The right has two stoves with pans and a plate. The bottom has a trash can, a plate, and a stove with a pot. The left side has a Fire Extinguisher, a stove with a pan, and the Plate Return.

levels.title: 2-2 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is split into 3 sections and the Serving Conveyor. Every section is connected by a long strip of floor. Rats come out of holes in the countertops and steal the tomatoes, onions and mushrooms, regardless of if they're chopped or not. They will go back to where they came from and the only way to hold them back is to sprint into them.

levels.title: 2-3 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a mostly symmetrical layout, with two Campfires to the left and another two to the right sides of the kitchen. The Service Counter is at the middle top and four Chopping Boards at the middle bottom. The Sink and the Ingredient Boxes for crackers and chocolate are to the left. The Bin, Plate Return and boxes for strawberries and bananas are to the right. The backpacks hold the marshmallows and firewood.

levels.title: 2-3 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of one large lower area with three small platforms at the top left, top centre and top right that can only be accessed by being launched with a cannon. The top left of such platforms has the Ingredient Box for mushrooms and a Chopping Board, the centre one has beef and another chopping board, and the right one has chicken and a chopping board. At the centre of the lower area there's a horizontal table and starts with the four Plates. South of that there's the Cannon. There's L-shaped countertops and kitchen utensils along the bottom left and bottom right corners of the lower area. On the left are the Plate Return, Service Counter, launch Button, three Pans and the control switch for the direction of the cannon. On the right are the Fire Extinguisher, the rice box, three Pots, the tortillas, the Sink and the Bin.

levels.title: 2-3 (Overcooked! 2 Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into left and right halves and there are four horizontal tables that will swap sides every 30 seconds. The top table will start on the right, blocking that side's Service Counter, and has (from left to right) the Bin, the Fire Extinguisher, the Furnace and two Chopping Boards. The next one continuing down starts on the left and has the Sink, the Plate Return, the Ingredient Box for coal and cherries. The following table starts on the right and has three Ovens and the ingredient boxes for flour and eggs in between them. The table at the bottom will start on the left and has three Mixers and the boxes for blackberries and apples in between them. Additionally, the bucket for coal will start at the top of the middle counter.

levels.title: 2-3 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: The kitchen has to working areas connected by a shared counter, and on the outside there's a conveyor belt going around in a circle that will periodically change direction. The Service Counter and the Plate Return are to the very right and the Sink and Bin are to the very left. The upper working station has two Pans, the Fire Extinguisher and the Ingredient Boxes for beef, lettuce and tomatoes. The lower working area has two Chopping Boards and the boxes for cheese, pineapple and buns.

levels.title: 2-3 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen is split up between three hot-air balloons, one per side and another one below them with 4 Countertops floating back and forth. The left side has the Sink, the Plate Return, the Serving Counter, a Chopping Board and all three Ingredient Boxes (left to right: Pasta, Mushrooms, Beef), while the right side also has a chopping board, but also a Trash Bin, four Plates, two Pans and two Pots, and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 2-3 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The main focus of this kitchen is a Conveyor Belt that streches across the level and runs in a circle around the kitchen clockwise. The Chefs must use it to send Ingredients and Plates. The Chef on the left has Ingredient boxes, two Pans with Burners, the Sink and the Fire Extinguisher. The chef on the right has the Chopping Stations, the Serving Counter, the Plate Return and Plates.

levels.title: 2-4 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into a left and right sides with a river at the middle where platforms with Service Counters will flow downwards at a constant speed without stopping. The left side has four Chopping Boards, the Sink and the Ingredient Boxes for eggs and beans. The right side has two Campfires, the Plate Return, the Bin and the boxes for bacon, sausages and firewood.

levels.title: 2-4 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen has four quadrants and two moving tables that will partially section off one quadrant at a time. These tables are almost half a kitchen long and will start off surrounding the lower left quadrant. Every ~16 seconds one of them will move and the sectioned off quadrant will, thus, change. They move so the surrounded quadrants change counter-clockwise. There are also two vertical tables at the leftmost and rightmost sides of the kitchen. The bottom right quadrant has three Chopping Boards at the centre and the Plate Return to its right. The bottom left quadrant has three Pans at the centre and the Bin to the left. The top left quadrant has the Ingredient Boxes for buns, sausages and onions at the centre, and the Sink and Condiment Machine at the top. The top right quadrant has three Pots at the centre and the Service Counter and the Button for condiments at the top.

levels.title: 2-4 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided in the middle by conveyor belts that end up at the Bin. The way to pass plates and bowls from one side to another is by putting them on their furthest end of the conveyor belt, and have the other chef pick it up before it ends up in the trash. The left side has two Mixers, the Sink, the Fire Extinguisher, the three Plates for this level, the Service Counter and the Ingredient Boxes for honey, chocolate and carrots. The right side has two Ovens, two Chopping Boards, the Plate Return and the ingredient boxes for eggs and flour.

levels.title: 2-4 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen has two sides, separated by a bridge. There are four total Plates in this level, three of which start out on the left and the other one on the right. The left side has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, two Pots and the Ingredient Boxes for tortillas and mushrooms. The right side has two Chopping Boards, the Sink, two Pans, the Bin, the Fire Extinguisher and the Ingredient Boxes for beef and rice.

levels.title: 2-4 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Separated Chefs, Conveyor Belts leading to Trash Bins
levels.overview: The level acts similarly to 2-3 (Overcooked!), with one chef having Chopping Stations, 3 Plates, the Serving Counter and the Plate Return, the other having Pans, the Sink, the Fire Extinguisher and Ingredient boxes. The only two differences are that there are 3 Pans and Burners instead of two in the lower half of the kitchen, and the Conveyor Belts not circling around the kitchen, rather leading to Trash Bins.

levels.title: 2-5 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The level is split between left and right, with a rail connecting them along the middle. There are four Ingredient Boxes for tortillas, beef, chicken and rice set along the counter that moves left and right at the height this middle rail, but they do so by hiding or showing a set of boxes outside the playable area, so the center always remains free of obstacles. There are four total Plates in this level, two of which start out on the bottom left and the other two on the top right. The left side has two Pots and the Sink on the top half, and three Cutting Boards and the Fire Extinguisher on the bottom half. The right side has the Service Counter and Plate Return on the top half, and the Bin and four Pans on the bottom half.

levels.title: 2-6 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: At the center of the kitchen there is a counter that starts out vertical and rotates counter-clockwise every 30 seconds. It has three Pans in total, one at the center and the other two at each end of the counter. It also starts out with the 4 Plates of this level. On the top left of the kitchen are three Ingredient Boxes for buns, beef and cheese. In the middle left there is the Sink. On the top right are two Chopping Boards, the Bin and the Fire Extinguisher. On the bottom left are the Service Counter and the Plate Return.

levels.title: 3-1 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen has three tables at the centre that will periodically come together to restrict movement. There are 2 Mixers above and below said tables, there are four Chopping Boards equally distributed amongst the tables, and Ingredient Boxes that, when all the tables are put together, have the carrots end up on the left side, and the blueberries and eggs on the right side. There's also a corridor at the bottom of the kitchen connecting both sides even if the tables are put together, and it's where the backpacks for flour and honey will be. At the top right are two Ovens, and to the top left are two Pans and the Fire Extinguisher. The Service Counter and Plate Return are to the very left and the Sink and Bin are to the very right.

levels.title: 3-1 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen has countertops along the outer edges and, at the centre, a winding narrow path. At the centre right of this path is the Button for the Cannon located at the top right corner of the kitchen, which launches chefs all the way down in front of the Service Counter at the bottom right. The Ingredient Boxes for raspberries, honey and chocolate are at the bottom counters of the winding path. The middle counter has three Chopping Boards and the button. The boxes for eggs and flour are to the right of the path. Then at the top counters of the path are three Mixers. At the bottom left corner of the kitchen is the Plate Return. At the top area of the kitchen are the Bin, Sink, three Deep Fryers, the three Plates for this level, the Fire Extinguisher and the aforementioned cannon.

levels.title: 3-1 (Overcooked! 2 Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into a left and right halves, with some shared countertop in the middle. There are moving tables at the top and bottom that will alternate in which side they're at every ~30 seconds. Each side has a pit with some countertops above and below them. They also have Guillotines that can be activated with the Button on the opposite side. The left side has the Service Counter and Plate Return. The middle shared countertop has the Ingredient Box for mushrooms. The right side has the Fire Extinguisher, the Sink and the Bin. The top moving table has three Pots and the ingredient boxes for tortillas and rice between them. The bottom moving table has three Pans and the boxes for beef and chicken between them.

levels.title: 3-1 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided horizontally in the middle by a countertop that has, symmetrically, two Chopping Boards, two Barbecues, the two Plates for this level, and the Ingredient Boxes for (from left to right) tomatoes, chicken, beef, mushrooms and pineapples. The top half has the Service Counter, the Bin, the Plate Return and the Bellows, while the bottom half has the Sink and the Fire Extinguisher. Throughout the level conga lines of pedestrians will move across the kitchen, temporarily blocking access to the kitchen utensils.

levels.title: 3-1 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen's top part is accessed by a set of stairs and holds the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Bin. On the bottom left are the Fire Extinguisher, the Ingredient Box for tomatoes and the three Plates for this level. On the bottom right are two Ovens, the Sink and the ingredient boxes for the dough and cheese. Between the bottom left and right halves, there is a counter with three Chopping Boards that will move to the left or right every approximately 30 seconds, changing which chef has access to the stairs, ovens and sink.

levels.title: 3-1 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Slippery Floor, Sea that punishes with 5 seconds for falling in
levels.overview: The kitchen is set up on an ice floe, and all of the Countertops are placed in the middle. The south part has Deep Fryers and Plates, the west part has the Sink, the north part has Chopping Stations and the Fire Extinguisher, while the east side has Ingredient boxes and one more Deep Fryer. In the upper-right corner a Trash Bin can be found. The Plate Return and the Serving Counter are north of the kitchen and are separate from all of the other Countertops.

levels.title: 3-2 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen narrows significantly at the middle section where the four Chopping Boards are. To the very left is the Service Counter and then four lines of Conveyor Belts that end up in Bins that will randomly spawn dough, cheese, tomatoes, chicken, pepperoni and olives. There are also the Plate Return and the Fire Extinguisher on the left side. At the top right there are three Ovens, and at the very right is the Sink.

levels.title: 3-2 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: This kitchen has some wide open left and right areas connected along the middle by three narrow corridors without walls to separate from the pit. The left wide area has the Sink and the Bin at the bottom, some countertops to the right, and at the top the Drinks Machine and the Ingredient Boxes for chicken, buns and beef. The right wide area has at the bottom the Button for the drinks and the ingredient boxes for cheese, onions and pototes, then some countertops to the left, and at the top the Fire Extinguisher, the Service Counter and the Plate Return. The top corridor has two Chopping Boards on its north side. The middle corridor has three Pans to its north and three Deep Fryers to its south. The bottom corridor has two chopping boards to its south.

levels.title: 3-2 (Overcooked! 2 Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between four quadrants with movable bridges connecting them either vertically or horizontally at the pull of a Lever. The top left quadrant has the Service Counter, a lever, the Bin and the Fire Extinguisher. The top right quadrant has three Pots and starts with the three Plates for this level. The bottom right quadrant has three Chopping Boards, a lever and the Sink. The bottom left quadrant has the Plate Return and the Ingredient Boxes for cheese, leeks, broccoli, potatoes, carrots and onions.

levels.title: 3-2 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: The kitchen is comprised of three working areas connected by narrow 1 block-wide corridors. Fire will randomly spawn at different areas of the kitchen which will extinguish themselves after some time has passed, or can be doused with the water gun. The middle area has two Chopping Boards, the Service Counter, the Water Gun and the Bin. The left area has a Blender, a Barbecue, the Bellows, the two Glasses, the Plate Return for glasses and the Ingredient Boxes for watermelons, strawberries, chicken and pineapples. The right area has another blender, another barbecue, the two Plates, the plate return for the plates and the ingredient boxes for tomatoes, mushrooms, bananas and beef.

levels.title: 3-2 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into three segments: left, middle and right. Middle is lower than the sides and connects with either side with a set of stairs. At start of the level middle and left are connected with stairs, but these change every 35 seconds. Left and right are always connected with portals. Left has the Ingredient Boxes for buns and lettuce and three Chopping Boards. Middle has the ingredient boxes for cheese and beef, as well as four Pans next to each corner that would connect to the stairs. Right has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Bin and the Fire Extinguisher. There are also portals on top that are connected (food can be thrown though).

levels.title: 3-2 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The chefs are separated in this kitchen and need to switch between handing Ingredients, serving and cooking to Chopping and bringing plates from the Plate Return.

levels.title: 3-3 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen is comprised of four interconnected quadrants. They all have a Campfire, a Chopping Board and an Ingredient Box: crackers at the top right, strawberries at the bottom right, bananas at the bottom left and chocolate at the top left. The Service Counter and Plate Return are at the top right, as well as the backpacks for marshmallows and firewood. The Sink is at the bottom left.

levels.title: 3-3 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen has two separate left and right working areas connected with conveyor belts that loop clockwise. The left side has three Pots, the four Plates, the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Sink, the Ingredient Boxes for buns and onions, and the Button for the condiments machine. The right side has the Condiment Machine, three Chopping Boards, the box for sausages, the Bin, the Fire Extinguisher and three Pans.

levels.title: 3-3 (Overcooked! 2 Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into three areas (left, middle right) with portals connecting the middle to either side. The left area has three Ovens, three Chopping Boards and starts with the four Plates for this level. The middle area has the Sink, the Bin, the Fire Extinguisher, the Ingredient Boxes for carrots, potatoes, chicken, beef, broccoli and coal, as well as the bucket for coal. The right area has the Furnace, the Service Counter and the Plate Return.

levels.title: 3-3 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into left and right areas that share countertops at the middle. Each side has a pool at the middle with a table and small safe area which will rotate when the button on the opposite area is activated, and after a few moments return to the original position. These tables have Ingredient Boxes that by default can't be accessed from the middle. Staying on the safe area while it rotates will allow chefs to gain access to the Plate Return and Bin on the left half, and to the Service Counter and Fire Extinguisher on the right half. The left working station has, close to the center of the map, two Chopping Boards, two Pans and the button for the right side's table. The right working station has, close to the center of the map, two Mixers and the button for the left side's table. On the left side's table there's the ingredient boxes for flour and eggs, while on the right side are for chocolate and strawberries.

levels.title: 3-3 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen can be divided in four quadrants, with Ingredient Boxes for dough, pepperoni, tomato and cheese that will move around blocking off areas. For the first 10 seconds of the level all quadrants are connected, but then the boxes will section off the kitchen vertically and will alternate with a horizontal split every 30~40 seconds. Top left has the Bin and a Chopping Board. Top right has another chopping board, the Fire Extinguisher and the Service Counter. Bottom right has an Oven and the Plate Return. Bottom left has another oven and the Sink. The three Plates for this level start out along the horizontal middle counters.

levels.title: 3-3 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Moving Trucks, 5 second penalty for falling off
levels.overview: The kitchen is once again split between moving trucks. The lower trucks contain cooking devices and Chopping Stations while the truck with the Plate Return, the Service Counter and the Ingredient boxes. The Pots are on the left side, while the Deep Fryers are on the right.

levels.title: 3-4 (Overcooked! 2 Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: Chefs will be split throughout all of this level on a top and bottom halves. ===Phase 1=== The top half has two Campfires, the Sink, the Bin and the Ingredient Boxes for firewood, bacon, eggs, sausages and beans. The bottom half has one campfire, two Chopping Boards, the Service Counter and the Plate Return. ===Phase 2=== At 4:51 remaining time most of the platform will detach from a safe corner at the left and float away. Any chefs and kitchen utensils remaining will respawn after 5 seconds, and any prepared food will be lost. The new setup is now divided by a long shared countertop with conveyor belts on either side throughout its length. The top half has two chopping boards, the service counter, the plate return and the boxes for eggs and beans. The bottom half has three campfires, the sink, the bin and the boxes for bacon, sausages and firewood. ===Phase 3=== At 3:21 remaining time most of the platform will float away again. Now there are boxes for beans and eggs in the shared countertop space. The top half has one campfire, the service counter and the plate return. The bottom half has one campfire, the sink and the bin. On the right and left sides there are tables that will move periodically throughout the phase. The left one starts at the top and has the boxes for sausages, bacon and firewood. The right one starts at the bottom and has two chopping boards. ===Phase 4=== At 1:51 remaining time the platform will transition one last time. Now two conveyor belts that converge into a bin will connect both sides. Each side will have access to the furthest point of one conveyor belt onto which drop items, and be close to the bin on the other one to receive objects. The top half has three campfires, the sink and the ingredient boxes for bacon, sausages and firewood. The bottom half has the service counter, plate return, two chopping boards and the boxes for beans and eggs.

levels.title: 3-4 (Overcooked! 2 Carnival of Chaos)
