levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into a central area and then four outer quadrants interconnected with cannons and portals. The central area has at the top two Pots, the Condiment Machine and two Mixers. At the centre are some countertops and the button for the condiments. At the bottom are two Pans, the Plate Return and two Deep Fryers. It shares two Chopping Boards with the top left quadrant and another two with the top right quadrant. It also has access to the Fire Extinguisher and the Buttons for the cannons. The top left quadrant has the Ingredient Boxes for buns, onions and sausages, and a maneuverable Cannon towards the top right and bottom right quadrants. The top right quadrant has the boxes for raspberries, chocolate, eggs and flour, and a maneuverable cannon to the top left and bottom left quadrants. The bottom right quadrant has the Service Counter and a one-way portal towards the top left quadrant. The bottom left quadrant has the Sink and a one-way portal towards the top right quadrant.

levels.title: 3-4 (Overcooked! 2 Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.obstacles: Isolated chefs, water gun, bellows, conveyor belts, moving tables
levels.overview: The top area on the deck outside the sand will always remain the same: the left side has the Service Counter, two Plates, a Plate Return for plates, and is where the Bellows will start and respawn at. The right side has the Bin, two Glasses, the plate return for glasses, and is where the Water Gun will respawn at. ===Phase 1=== During this phase each side has a U shaped working kitchen and they share some countertops at the middle. The left side has a Chopping Board, the two Blenders and the Ingredient Boxes for tomatoes, pineapples, chicken, beef and mushrooms. The right side has two Barbecues, another chopping board and the ingredient boxes for bananas, strawberries and watermelons. ===Phase 2=== At 4:55 time remaining a wave will clear the sand and rearrange the kitchen. Any chef or item caught in it will respawn after 5 seconds. All ingredients and meals washed away will be lost. Dirty dishes won't be cleaned by this. Now both sides will have an L-shaped conveyor belt that converge into a bin, similar to level 2-4. The left side will have the two barbecues now, two chopping boards and the ingredient boxes for bananas, strawberries and watermelons. The right side will have the two blenders, another two chopping boards and the ingredient boxes for tomatoes, pineapples, chicken, mushrooms and beef. ===Phase 3=== At 3:25 time remaining another wave will rearrange the kitchen. There will be three horizontal working areas that start out connected by small vertical countertops in an S shape. Wind will periodically blow these vertical sections from left to right, restricting to which working area (top or bottom) each side has access to. The top counter has, from left right, the boxes for pineapples, tomatoes, chicken, beef, mushrooms and two blenders. The middle counter has two chopping boards at the centre. And the bottom counter has two barbecues and the boxes for strawberries, melons and bananas. ===Phase 4=== At 1:55 time remaining a wave will rearrange the kitchen one last time. Chefs will no longer be forcefully separated, but the countertops will shape narrow labyrinthine paths. The two chopping boards will be at the middle, whereas barbecues, blenders and ingredient boxes will be scattered around the whole kitchen.

levels.title: 3-4 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between three sections: a middle raised area, and left and right sides. The middle connects to either side through portals, and has the Service Counter and the Plate Return. The left and right sides have an uncrossable rift between them but ingredients can be tossed across. Left side has two Chopping Boards, three Pans and the Fire Extinguisher. Right side has the Sink, the Bin and the Ingredient Boxes for (from left to right) tomatoes, cheese, beef, buns and lettuce. The four Plates for this level start out two on the left side and the other two on the right.

levels.title: 3-4 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is set up on a camp near a freezing cold river, on which ice floes float by. The chefs must use those floes to cross from the left side to the right side, and vice-versa. The left side posseses all Ingredient boxes, two Deep Fryers with Frying Baskets, the Fire Extinguisher and the Sink at the bottom. The left side has two Chopping Boards, the Plate Return, the Service Counter, two Plates and an additional easy-to-access Deep Fryer with a basket. Falling into the frozen waters results in a Time Penalty +5 seconds for the chef that fell in.

levels.title: 3-5 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: There are two floating rafts in this level. The left raft has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, two Deep Fryers and the Ingredient Boxes for potatoes and chicken. The right raft has two Chopping Boards, the Sink, the Bin, the Fire Extinguisher and starts out with the two Plates for this level. The two rafts will occasionally move around and at times they will be too far apart to walk between them.

levels.title: 3-6 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into three platforms: one at the top, another at the bottom, and a third one swinging across the middle and connecting the other two. The top platform has two Chopping Boards, two Pans, the Fire Extinguisher and the Service Counter. The bottom platform has two Pots, the Bin and the Plate Return. The middle platform has all four Ingredient Boxes, with the rice and chicken on the top right corner, and the beef and chicken on the bottom left corner. After 2 minutes and 20 seconds, the platforms will start floating along the river as rafts. The middle raft will briefly disappear during this transition. The three rafts will move during this last part, but will remain mostly connected.

levels.title: 4-1 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen has a left and right sides with a road that has cars crossing it when the traffic light turns green that can run over the chefs. The left side has two Pots, two Chopping Boards, the Sink, the cucumber Ingredient Box and a Conveyor Belt that will spawn rice and nori. The right side has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Fire Extinguisher, the Bin and another conveyor belt that spawns prawns and fish.

levels.title: 4-1 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is set in the haunted forest. The kitchen is divided by a set of Countertops, two with Chopping Stations and three with Plates. These Countertops move every once in a while, blocking off the chefs and switching from them having to do dishes and serving. The upper half of the kitchen has 3 Ovens, while the other has Ingredient boxes. A narrow hallway on the left can be used to access both sides. br

levels.title: 4-2 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.obstacles: Moving platforms, conveyor belts, isolated chefs
levels.overview: The chefs are split between two rafts that will alternate between being connected vertically and horizontally. They each have an L-shaped Conveyor Belt that ends up in a Bin and when the rafts are close enough, leaving plates on these is the only way to move them across rafts. The top raft has two Deep Fryers, the Sink, a Cutting Board and the Ingredient Boxes for tomatoes and lettuces. The bottom raft has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Fire Extinguisher, two chopping boards and the boxes for potatoes and chicken.

levels.title: 4-2 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen takes place in the Munch Mansion near the cementary, and there are no lights. The kitchen layout itself is simple, but due to the absence of light remembering it might be tough. The Service Counter and the Plate Return is in the top-right corner alongside Plates, to the left of them is one Pot on a Burner, and to the left of it is a Chopping Board. There is a second Chopping Board and the Sink in the top-left corner, and in the middle of the left handside is a second Pot. Under it is the Onion Ingredient box. There is a middle counter in this kitchen that is 2 Countertops wide. On its upper side is the Trash Bin and on the lower side is the source of Tomatoes. In the lower-left corner Mushrooms can be found.

levels.title: 4-3 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between a left and right side connected with S-shaped Conveyor Belts that will swap direction every 30 seconds. Left side has the Service Counter, the Sink and the Ingredient Boxes for the buns, beef, cheese and lettuce. It's also where the three Plates start at. The right side has two Pans, two Chopping Boards, the Bin, the Plate Return and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 4-3 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Moving Chopping Board, Ingredient box and Burners, Semi-separated Chefs
levels.overview: <gallery type="slideshow"> File:oc14-3phase1.jpg|Countertop change #1 File:oc14-3phase2.jpg|Countertop change #2 File:oc14-3phase3.jpg|Countertop change #3 File:oc14-3phase4.jpg|Countertop change #4 File:oc14-3phase5.jpg|Countertop change #5 </gallery> The kitchen is split into four quadrants, the bottom-left has Ingredient boxes, the top-left has the Chopping Board and the Sink, and the right quadrants have one Burner with Pan each. Three Plates are placed on Countertops between them. Additionaly, the Plate Return and the Service Counter is placed in the top-right corner. The kitchen constantly switches the places of the Burners, the Beef Ingredient box and the Chopping Board, putting them in between quadrants, blocking off parts of the kitchen, while revealing other passageways. This makes the chefs separated.

levels.title: 4-4 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.obstacles: Conveyor belt, bottleneck, wind, moving tables
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between left and right sides, connected with two bridges at the top and bottom. At the same height as these bridges there will be gusts of wind that will change directions every ~13 seconds. If the upper wind blows left, the lower one will blow right, and viceversa. There are also some short counters going up and down at a similar tempo as the winds on the far right and left sides of the kitchen. The left side has a Chopping Board, the Sink, a Deep Fryer and the Ingredient Box for the chicken. The right side has another chopping board, fryer and box with potatoes, as well as the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 4-4 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is split into two halves, each one of them has a Service Counter, a Plate Return, a Sink, two Plates and a Chopping Board. The left side has Pans and Burners, while the right side has Ovens, and the two sides have opposite Ingredients (the left side has Pizza Ingredient boxes; the right side has food for Burgers. There is a Conveyor Belt leading to the Trash Bin in the middle going down the chefs can use to share food with each other. The kitchen constantly switches the height of the kitchen areas, allowing the other chef to share ingredients.

levels.title: 4-5 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.obstacles: Conveyor belts, isolated chefs, switches, two plates
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between a top and a bottom half. There is a Conveyor Belt going all around the kitchen and connecting the halves from the outside, and another set of conveyor belts at the middle in the shape of two overlapping Ls that end up in Bins. In the middle, where the conveyor belts overlap, the direction can be adjusted with Buttons on each side that will redirect items on the belt towards their respective half. The top half has two Pots, the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Ingredient Boxes for nori and rice. The top half has two Cutting Boards, the Sink, the Fire Extinguisher and the ingredient boxes for the fish and cucumber. There are two Plates in this level, each one starting on either half of the kitchen.

levels.title: 4-6 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.obstacles: Conveyor belts, bottlenecks, moving tables, fire
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between a right and a left side connected with walkable Conveyor Belts at the top and bottom. The top conveyor belt goes towards the right, and the bottom one towards the left. Along the rightmost and leftmost walls there are two sets of counters that will alternate what they contain every 30 seconds. The left one will start out with Ingredient Boxes for rice, chicken and mushrooms; and the right one with two Chopping Boards and the ingredient boxes with tortillas and beef. The left side has the Sink, the Bin and two Pans. The right side has two Pots, the Service Counter and the Plate Return.

levels.title: 5-1 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between a left and right side, and a movable middle platform that bridges the river between them. This middle platform has a vertical line of countertops with a joystick in the middle to move it and it's where the three Plates will initially be. The left side has two Pots, two Pans, the Bin and the Ingredient Boxes for the buns, nori and rice. The right side has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Sink, two Cutting Boards, the Fire Extinguisher and the ingredient boxes for cucumber, beef and fish.

levels.title: 5-1 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Separated Chefs (1-2 Players), Buttons, Shared Ingredients
levels.overview: The kitchen is set up in space, and has two cooking chambers on the left and on the right, which include a Pan, a Pot, two Burners, a Chopping Board, a Service Counter, a Plate Return and two Plates. A moving chamber controlled with buttons is used to provide Ingredient Boxes, the Sink and the Trash Bin for both chefs. The button that is green (which is on the side the chamber is on, the other is always red) will send the chamber to the other side.

levels.title: 5-2 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: This level has two working areas connected through a corridor around them. The Service Counter is to the leftmost part of the kitchen. The left working station has one Pan, a Cutting Board, the Bin and the Ingredient Boxes for cheese and tomatoes. It has exits towards the outer ring corridor at the top, left and bottom. It shares the Sink and the buns ingredient box with the right area. The right working station has two pans, a cutting board, the ingredient boxes for lettuce and beef, the Plate Return and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 5-2 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is set in the Molten Magma; a town covered by lava. This kitchen has four quadrants, each one can be reached via bridges made out of rocks. Only 3 out of 4 bridges are active at once, and when they change, one falls into the lava, and the other rises. Falling into the lava gives a Time Penalty. The lower-right quadrant has the Service Counter and the Plate Return, the lower-left has the Sink and all Ingredient Boxes, the upper-left has the Fire Extinguisher, a Pot on a Burner, a Countertop and a Chopping Board, and the upper-right has the Trash Bin, more Countertops, two Plates and two Pans on Burners. A cannon is present shooting down the middle of the kitchen, acting as an additional threat to chefs.

levels.title: 5-3 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The chefs will be maneuvering a moveable platform to interact with the utensils arranged in a circle surrounding the pit where the platform is located. There are three Pots at the bottom left and three Pans at the bottom right. The left wall has the Ingredient Boxes for rice, beef, chicken, mushrooms and tortillas. There is the Sink at the top left and three Cutting Boards at the top right. The right wall has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Bin and the Fire Extinguisher. The four Plates for this level start at a corner each.

levels.title: 5-3 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The Chefs are separated here, requiring to pass Ingredients on the Countertops. There are two Pressure Plates in the kitchen, and they allow chefs to open passageways for each other to reach the right side of the kitchen (the upper chef(s) get access to Chopping Boards and the lower chef(s) get access to every ingredient except for Rice). The left side of the kitchen has the Fire Extinguisher and Burners with Cookware at the bottom, while the top has Plates, the Rice Ingredient Box, the Service Counter and the Plate Return. There is no Sink in this kitchen, thus making the process of cooking in it easier.

levels.title: 5-4 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into three sections: top right, top left and bottom. The bottom section starts off connected to the upper parts through two sets of stairs that disappear and reappear again every approximately 35 seconds. When the stairs disappear, portals will appear instead. Going through the ones at the top sections will teleport chefs into the bottom section. There is an additional portal floating left and right over the top sections, and going through the portal at the bottom section will spawn the chefs wherever the moving portal is currently at, even into the pit as it moves across sections. The top left section has the Sink, the Plate Return, the Ingredient Box for chocolate and initially has the two Plates for this level. The top right section has the flour, two Chopping Boards and the Service Counter. The bottom section has two Mixers, two Pans, the ingredient box for eggs, the Bin and the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: 5-4 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is once again set in Melting Magma, this time on 2 separated platforms with Ingredient Boxes and Chopping Board on each of them. There is a Plate Return with two clean Plates on top of it and the Service Counter. There are the Rice and Beef Ingredient Boxes on the left, while the ones with Chicken and Tortillas are on the right. There is a Pan on the left Countertops while a Pot is placed on the right ones. These move around the platforms in a form of the Infinity Symbol (∞). 3 Countertops and 3 Burners circle around the two platform, allowing chefs to cook and pass ingredients to each other. One of the Burners has a Pan on it, one has a Pot, and one is free.

levels.title: 5-5 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into four corners with one long counter splitting the level vertically across the middle into left and right sides. There are also two small moveable platforms that can be controlled by the chefs on the opposite side, so for example the switches in the top left and bottom left corners will move the platform on the right half. The top left corner has the Service Counter and three Pans. The top right corner has three Pots and starts out with the three Plates for this level. Between top right and bottom right there is the Sink. The bottom right corner has the Plate Return, the Bin and the Ingredient Boxes for mushrooms and pasta. The bottom left corner has another bin, the Fire Extinguisher and the boxes for beef and tomatoes. Finally, between the top left and bottom left there are two Chopping Boards.

levels.title: 5-5 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The level features two side chambers that can be transfered between the two sides of the main area by pressing buttons on corresponding sides. There are Countertops and Trash Bin inside both chambers. The upper half consists of Ingredient Boxes, Burners with Pots on top of them, the Service Counter, the Sink, the Plate Return and some more Countertops. The lower half has two Chopping Boards and three Plates. There are lots of Countertops.

levels.title: 5-6 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: ===Phase 1=== At the start the kitchen will be split into three distinct sections: top right, bottom right, and left sides. The chefs can only walk between islands when small pieces of land flow and connect them. The left side has two Pots and the Ingredient Boxes for mushrooms, tomatoes, beef and pasta. The bottom right side has two Pans, two Chopping Boards, the Sink and it's where the three Plates for the level are initially located. The top right side has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Bin and the Fire Extinguisher. ===Phase 2=== At 3:48 remaining time the area will transition to phase two. The river separating the islands will disappear, leaving in its place solid land with a vortex animation/voidhole and gentle sway of the camera that may cause nausea. In the beginning all the kitchen utensils will start out at the same place as they were in phase 1, but then counters will split and slide across the kitchen throughout this phase, finally ending up in the place they are situated in phase 3. ===Phase 3=== At 1:58 remaining time the area will change once more to a final phase. The kitchen will be largely split between left and right side. The left side has the same counter with the two burners (that originally held the pots, if those haven't been moved) and all the ingredient boxes. Additionally, it will have the service counter, the return plate and the boxes for fish and prawns. Dropping from a small ledge will get the chefs to the right area, which holds the rest of the kitchen utensils, as well as an additional Pot and Burner. Players can use the portal to go back to the left side.

levels.title: 5-6 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.obstacles: Separated Chefs, Pressure Plates, Conveyor Belts
levels.overview: The kitchen features four rooms separated by walls and doors opened by stepping onto Pressure Plates. The chefs are separated, and must use Conveyor Belts to pass objects to each other. The upper left corner has the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Trash Bin and the conveyor that sends products down to the lower left corner. The aformentioned area has 2 Pots on Burners, the Sink, and the Fire Extinguisher. It also has the pressure plate opening a passage between the two upper sections. It has the Onion Ingredient Box too. The lower right section has 3 Plates, and the Tomato and Mushroom Ingredient boxes. There is a Conveyor Belt section that sends products to the upper right section. That section only has Chopping Boards and a Pressure Plate that allows for opening the lower door.

levels.title: 6-1 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen has three working areas (top, middle, bottom) connected by conveyor belts to the left, and a corridor to the right. At the top there are two Ovens, the Plate Return, a Bin and the Ingredient Boxes for flour and chocolate. The bottom has the two Mixers, the Sink and the boxes for eggs, carrots and honey. The middle has the two Chopping Boards, the Fire Extinguisher and initally has the three Plates for this level. The high walls prevent players from tossing ingredients towards the middle. Instead, they can be delivered through the conveyor belts or by bringing them through the corridor. Finally, the Service Counter is the right of the kitchen.

levels.title: 6-1 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is set up on a ship, and has a large Countertop filled with Ingredient Boxes. On that very countertop are two Pots and a Fire Extinguisher on the left, barely visible in sight. The top and bottom sections both have two Burners, and there is a Service Counter and the Plate Return with 3 Plates at the top additionally. The main hazard of this kitchen is a set of two Chopping Boards and a Countertop between them that move around the ship in a rectangular pattern starting from the top-left corner and going clockwise. Once the structure slides upwards/downwards, a set of two lonely Countertops at the opposite side of the Chopping Boards shift as well, allowing for the chefs to change sides. There is no Sink in this kitchen.

levels.title: 6-2 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The level is segmented into three islands: top, right and left. Chefs can only move between them when a platform rises above the water level. They remain on the surface for about 13 seconds and then sink for about 5. Their shapes will change following a specific order, ranging from big chunks of land to narrow winding paths. All chefs will start at the left island, which has two Mixers, two Pans, two Cutting Boards, the Sink and the Fire Extinguisher. The right island has the Service Counter, the Bin and the Ingredient Boxes for eggs and chocolate. The top island has two Ovens, the Plate Return and the ingredient boxes for flour, honey and carrots.

levels.title: 6-2 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: ===4 Player Version=== Each chef is separated and put into their own quadrant in this version. The lower-left and the upper-right quadrants have all of the Ingredient Boxes, a single Pot on a Burner and the Sink, while the upper-left and the lower-right have Service Counters, Plate Returns, Chopping Boards and two Plates. Conveyor Belts are present in the kitchen, allowing chefs to pass items to each other in a clockwise direction. All conveyors eventually lead to Trash Bins. ===1-3 Player Version=== Each chef basically has their own kitchen here (except when this level is played in 3 players, then the third chef joins the left kitchen), because the chefs have everything needed to cook Soups, with no need to pass items to each other. While this is still possible with the help of Conveyor Belts that lead to Trash Bins, it is pointless. The left kitchen has a Service Counter, a Plate Return, 2 Plates and the Chopping Board at the bottom, while having the Tomato and Onion Ingredient boxes, two Pots on Burners and a Sink. The right kitchen is pretty much identical to the left one, except that it is flipped 180 degrees and has a Mushroom Ingredient Box instead of the Tomato one.

levels.title: 6-3 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: This level features conveyor belts which will carry ingredients before dropping them at Bins. The ingredients will be out of reach unless their corresponding button is pressed, which will redirect them so they can be picked up by players. The left button redirects flour and chocolate, and the right button redirects eggs and honey. Two Cutting Boards are at the bottom left; two Mixers and the Fire Extinguisher are at the top left; two Ovens and the Sink are at the top right; and two Pans, the Service Counter and the Plate Return are on the bottom right.

levels.title: 6-3 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is set up on a side of a frozen river, on which ice floes come by. There are two rows of floes. The left ones go upwards, while the right ones float downwards. Unlike the predecessor of this kitchen, the floes differ in shaped and sizes and come rather quickly. The left side of the kitchen has a Countertop in the middle that has a Fire Extinguisher on the very right, which splits it in half. The upper section has two Pots on Burners, while the lower half has a Trash Bin and the Onion & Mushroom Ingredient boxes. The right side has 3 Plates at the bottom and to the right of them is the Tomato Ingredient Box. Just above all of that is the Plate Return and the Service Counter, followed by a Sink and two Chopping Boards at the top.

levels.title: 6-4 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: The kitchen is a floating balloon platform with two control sticks that move two 2x2 Ingredient Box platforms around it. The layout it mostly symmetrical, with the kitchen utensils at the center, and the Sink to the right. The left ingredient box platform contains cheese, buns, beef and dough, and the right one contains lettuce, tomatoes, pepperoni and chicken.

levels.title: 6-4 (Overcooked!)
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is centered around rotating the outside chambers to access different ingredients, both Plate Returns and both Service Counters. These can be rotated by pressing buttons inside the center chamber. Pressing the left button will rotate the structure 90 degrees counterclockwise, while pressing the right button rotates it 90 degrees clockwise. Only two chambers that are on opposite sides can be accessed at once. The middle chamber has very limited cooking space, in fact there are only 4 Countertops (not including the one occupied by a Fire Extinguisher in the bottom left corner) in the middle. There are two Chopping Boards alongside 4 Burners, two are occupied by Pots while the other two have Pans on them. A Sink and a Trash Bin can be found at the bottom. This section lists the contents of the outside chambers that rotate *Pair 1 **Lettuce Ingredient Box, two Plates, Plate Return, Service Counter **Mushroom Ingredient Box, two Plates, Plate Return, Service Counter *Pair 2 **Tomato and Onion Ingredient boxes **Bun and Beef Ingredient boxes

levels.title: 6-5 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.overview: Chefs will be split between the top half or the bottom half of the kitchen. Ingredients and dishes can be passed between them through a circular conveyor belt at the middle. Each half has their own right and left sections, which will alternately sink every 45 seconds, signaled with a rumble. Each left side has two Pans and the Ingredient Boxes for buns, cheese, beef and lettuce. Each right side has two Chopping Boards and a Bin. The top half has access to the Service Counter and the Plate Return, and the bottom half has the Sink, the Fire Extinguisher and starts out with the three Plates for this level.

levels.title: 6-6 (Overcooked! 2)
levels.recipes: Salad, Sashimi, Sushi, Pasta, Burrito, Pizza, Cake, Pancake
levels.obstacles: Moving tables, buttons for opening doors, conveyor belts, portals
levels.overview: The kitchen will change as you deliver dishes. You will prepare two of each type of dish that have been served throughout the game, roughly in the order that they have appeared. Their order is set to always be the same. At the start the Service Counter and the Plate Return will be closed by a gate at the bottom right. This gate can be opened with a button from either side of it. The first dishes will require chopping, cooking on pots and pans, and deepfrying. After finishing the burgers the layout will change to one with portals and conveyor belts. The dishes on this second part will involve chopping, cooking in pots and pans, mixing and baking.

levels.title: Horde 1
levels.overview: The waves of unbread will attack the two Service Barriers at the top of the kitchen. There are three Chopping Boards at the middle left, and three Pans at the middle right. Then one long counter along the bottom of the kitchen with (from left to right) the Sink, the Bin, the Plate Return, the Fire Extinguisher and the Ingredient Boxes for buns, beef, cheese and lettuce.

levels.title: Horde 2
levels.overview: Defend from waves coming at the two Service Barriers at the top and one at the top left of the kitchen. The kitchen itself is split between a top and a bottom half which share countertops with two Chopping Boards between them. The top half has the Sink and the Plate Return. The bottom half has two Ovens (one to the left, the other to the right), the Bin, the Fire Extinguisher and the Ingredient Boxes for cheese, tomatoes, pepperoni and dough.

levels.title: Horde 3
levels.overview: The waves of unbread will attack the two Service Barriers at the left and the one at the top right of the kitchen. The kitchen will be divided in a left and right halves, with bridges that will alternate between connecting the top or the bottom parts of each half every ~30 seconds. The left half has three Pans and two Pots along the tables at the top, some empty countertops at the middle, and the Plate Return and Ingredient Boxes for beef and mushrooms at the bottom. The right side has the Bin, the Sink and the Fire Extinguisher at the top, some empty countertops at the middle, and four Chopping Boards and the ingredient box for pasta at the bottom.

levels.title: Horde 4
levels.overview: The waves of unbread will attack the two Service Barriers at the left and right sides of the kitchen. There's a vertical countertop along the middle that splits the kitchen between left and right halves. There are two moving tables (one at the top and another one at the bottom) that will swap sides every ~50 seconds. The top table has three Pans and the Ingredient Boxes for tortillas and rice in between them. The bottom table has three Pots and the ingredient boxes for beef and chicken in between them. Each half has a square of countertops with a Chopping Board at the left and right sides. The left half also has the Sink in their square, and the right also has the Bin and Plate Return.

levels.title: Horde 5
levels.overview: The waves of unbread will attack the Service Barriers at the top and to the right and left of the kitchen. The kitchen has a horizontal wall that goes through most of the middle, with an Unlockable Gate for 100 coins. At the top right corner are Ingredient Boxes for beef and cheese. There's a countertop along the bottom wall that also has the Bin, the Fire Extinguisher, the three Plates for this level, the Sink and two Pans. At the top left are the ingredient boxes for cheese, lettuce and tomatoes. Above the horizontal wall are the Plate Return and four Chopping Boards. The wall section in front of the two leftmost chopping boards allows ingredients to be tossed through.

levels.title: Horde 6
levels.overview: The waves of unbread will attack the Service Barriers at each side of the kitchen. At the center there is a table that will rotate half a turn counter clockwise every ~25 seconds. This rotating table has the Sink, the Bin opposite to it, and Ingredient Boxes (starting at the sink and going clockwise) for prawns, tomatoes, mushrooms, fish and beef. At the bottom left are three Chopping Boards, and at the bottom right three Pans. At the top left are two Pots, then at the top middle left the Plate Return, at the top middle right the box for pasta, and at the top right the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: Horde 7
levels.overview: The waves of unbread will attack the two Service Barriers at the left and right sides of the kitchen and one at the bottom. At the centre of the kitchen there's a small cooking station with an extra Pot and a Pan, locked behind an Unlockable Gate that will unlock for 200 coins. On the top left corner are two pots and at the top right corner two pans. To the left of the left wall of the central cooking area are three Chopping Boards, and to the right of the right wall are the Ingredient Boxes for beef, chicken and mushrooms. At the bottom left are the Sink and the Fire Extinguisher, and at the bottom right are the Plate Return, Bin and boxes for rice and tortillas.

levels.title: Horde 8
levels.overview: The waves of unbread will attack the two Service Barriers at the left and right sides of the kitchen and at the middle top. The kitchen has a combination of walls, countertops and Unlockable Gates that, to start with, form a spiral of a corridor to reach the cooking area at the middle bottom. There's a gate just right of this cooking area which costs 200 coins to unlock, and another one to the left that costs 100 coins. This cooking area has two Chopping Boards, the Plate Return and the Bin. At the top left are three Ovens and the three Plates for this level. At the top right are the Sink and the Ingredient Boxes for tomatoes, cheese, chicken and pepperoni. In a different corner also on the top right is the box for dough. At the bottom right is the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: Intro Apocalypse
levels.overview: The level is quite simple because there is no Sink. For 1 player, there are 2 cutting boards and on the right of those is a 5 spaced counter. On the left is a 6 spaced counter, the one before being 5 so the player has a space to walk through. On the other side are 2 Ingredient boxes, holding Lettuce and Tomato. Right next to that is the Ever Peckish. For 2-4 players, the 5-block counter on the right of the cutting boards has been replaced with a six-block counter, blocking the pathway off.

levels.title: Kevin 1
levels.overview:
The kitchen has two sides, with the players split up between them.
The middle Countertops have the plates and a bin above them.
The right side has 2 Ingredient Boxes (Flour and Fish) while the left side has 1 ingredient box (Beef).
The left side has two Mixers and the right side has two Steamers. Both sides have three sections. *The top has the Plate stuff (Sink on the left side, Plate Return and Service Counter on the right). *The middle has stairs leading down to it, and two cutting boards per side, each opposite of the mixers/steamers. *The bottom has the ingredient boxes.

levels.title: Kevin 1 (Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into four quadrants connected with four pairs of colour-coded portals between them. The bottom left quadrant has three Mixers. The top left quadrant has three Chopping Boards, the Sink, the Bin and the Fire Extinguisher. The top right quadrant has three Steamers and is where the four Plates start. The bottom right quadrant has the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Ingredient Boxes (from left to right) carrots, beef, flour and prawns.

levels.title: Kevin 1 (Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into a left and right halves, and between them there's a system of conveyor belts that will allow input from one place on either side, and then will deliver it to one of three possible exits on the other side. The left side has the Ingredient Boxes for shrimp and flour, the Service Counter, the Sink and three Mixers. The right side has the boxes for carrots and beef, the Bin, the Plate Return, the Fire Extinguisher, two Chopping Boards, three Steamers and starts with the three Plates.

levels.title: Kevin 1 (Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between a left and right sides, with some shared countertops at the middle. To start with the right side will be higher up and have access to the middle countertops, and the left side will be lower down. Either side can rise their own platform and lower the other one by pressing their button. The left side has two Chopping Boards at the bottom, three Steamers and four Plates at the top, and to the left the Fire Extinguisher, the Service Counter and the Plate Return. The right side has three Mixers at the top, the Sink and Bin to the right, and the Ingredient Boxes for flour, fish, prawns, beef and carrots at the bottom.

levels.title: Kevin 1 (Surf 'n' Turf)
levels.obstacles: Isolated chefs, conveyor belts, control stick
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between two working station separated by a pool. There's a platform on the pool that allows passing items between both sides that can be moved with control sticks from either side. This platform consists of conveyor belts going both ways through the middle, a Sink to the left and two Chopping Boards to the right. The top working station has two Steamers, the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Ingredient Box for flour. The bottom working station has two Mixers, the Bin and the boxes for carrots, beef and fish.

levels.title: Kevin 2
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of two Countertops in the middle with four 3 by 3 squares around them that get pushed first clockwise and then counterclockwise starting at 3:00 remaining time every ~23 seconds. Each square has a single plate. *The top left square has two steamers, the fire extinguisher and the sink. *The top right square has the Plate Return, another steamer and Ingredient Boxes for Prawn and Flour. *The bottom left square has the bin and ingredient boxes for Fish, Carrots and Beef. *The bottom right square has three Cutting Boards and two mixers.

levels.title: Kevin 2 (Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: The kitchen is a square with long tables going across it either vertically or horizontally, swappable at will by pushing a button. More specifically, there are four tables that each span half the kitchen and will move outside of the kitchen walls when inactive, and slide in when active. This allows for movement of chefs across any quadrants while the swap happens. The top vertical table has three Chopping Boards. The bottom vertical table has a Button and the Ingredient Boxes for fish, flour, beef and carrots. The left horizontal table has three Steamers. The right horizontal table has two Mixers and a button. On each of the corners of the kitchen there's a bit of countertop space. At the very top right are the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Fire Extinguisher. At the bottom left are the Sink and the Bin.

levels.title: Kevin 2 (Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: The kitchen has an endless table with Chopping Boards at the top that will move to the right. At the bottom of the kitchen is another table that moves to the left with Ingredient Boxes for flour, carrots, beef and shrimp. There's a table at the centre and conveyor belts that move chefs who are above this central table to the right, and those who are below it to the left. This central table has the Fire Extinguisher, three Steamers, three Mixers and the three Plates. At the right there's a small area without moving conveyor belts that has the Service Counter and Plate Return. To the left there's another small area without conveyor belts that has the Sink and the Bin.

levels.title: Kevin 2 (Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of a ring along the walls with two movable platforms that can be moved around the centre to get to the different kitchen utensils. One platform has countertops at the bottom and left, preventing it from interacting with the items on those same corners on the outer ring of the kitchen, and the other platform has countertops at the top and right, also preventing it from interacting with those sides. On the outer ring of the kitchen, there are two Ingredient Boxes for flour and prawns at the top left, as well as two Chopping Boards. At the top middle are the Sink and the Bin. At the top right are three Mixers. At the bottom right are the ingredient boxes for beef and carrots as well as two Chopping Boards. At the bottom middle are the Service Counter and the Plate Return. At the bottom left are three Steamers and the four Plates for this level. At the top left is the Fire Extinguisher.

levels.title: Kevin 3
levels.overview: The kitchen is split between a lower level, a top high level and a right high level which are all connected by an elevator that moves up and down. On the lower level are two Mixers, the Service Counter, the Plate Return, the Fire Extinguisher and the Ingredient Boxes for beef, carrots and fish. The right high level has two Chopping Boards and shares countertop space with the top high level. The top high level has three Steamers, the Sink, the Bin and the ingredient boxes for flour and prawns.

levels.title: Kevin 3 (Campfire Cook Off)
levels.overview: This kitchen has three long conveyor belts ending in Bins that create a winding long corridor at the middle. These conveyor belts will randomly spawn the ingredients required for the dumplings. There are also long countertops at the very top and bottom of the kitchen. The top one has a Fire Extinguisher, three Chopping Boards, three Steamers and starts with the three Plates. The bottom one has three Mixers, the Sink, the Plate Return and the Service Counter.

levels.title: Kevin 3 (Carnival of Chaos)
levels.overview: This kitchen has countertops and kitchen utensils in an outer ring, and a central platform with four countertops and a control switch. This central platform does not move and starts surrounded by a pit, but the control switch can move the rest of the floor to gain access to the outer ring. Starting from the top left of the ring and going clockwise, at the top there are two Plates, the Service Counter, two more plates, the Ingredient Boxes for carrots, prawns and beefs and the Bin; at the right are three Chopping Boards; at the bottom are the Plate Return, the Sink, the flour and three Mixers; at the left are the Fire Extinguisher and three Steamers.

levels.title: Kevin 3 (Night of the Hangry Horde)
levels.overview: The kitchen consists of a central lower area with four working stations higher up that can be accessed by stepping onto moving platforms that keep going up and down. At the centre are the Ingredient Boxes for carrots, beef, prawns and flour as well as the four Plates for this level. At the very bottom are the Service Counter, the Plate Return and the Fire Extinguisher. At the working station at the very left are three Chopping Boards. At the middle left station are three Mixers. At the middle right stations are three Steamers. At the rightmost station are the Sink and the Bin.

levels.title: Kevin 4
levels.overview: The kitchen is a rectangle that has a large fireplace in the center that shoots fire everywhere. On the top is the Plate Return, three Chopping Boards and the Serving Counter. On the left, there is a Mixer, with two Steamers, separated by countertops one down and one right of each ingredient making machine. The Bin is on the lowest tile. On the right is the exact same, but mirrored and with the trash bin replaced by an area with a Sink at the end, and a Fire Extinguisher at the top of the area. On the bottom is all five Ingredient Boxes (Fish, Flour, Carrots, Prawn and Beef) with plates in between them.

levels.title: Kevin 5
levels.overview: This kitchen consists of two 2x5 working areas, one on the upper half of the screen and the other one on the lower half. There are cars randomly driving between them. The working station on the upper half starts on the right, the one on the lower half starts on the left. Wind occasionally blows from where the rectangles are to make them swap sides. Careful though, this wind can also blow players! *The lower area has two Steamers on its right, and three Chopping Boards on its left, with the Flour Ingredient Box above them. *The upper area has two Mixers on its left, and all the other ingredient boxes on the right. There are two tiles of objects in each corner of the playable area. If it's plates or the fire extinguisher: they come with a countertop. *Top left: Two plates *Top right: Sink *Bottom left: Plate Return and Trash Bin *Bottom right: Plate and Fire Extinguisher The Serving Counter is middle-right.

levels.title: Kevin 6
levels.overview: The kitchen is divided into four quadrants that have a part open so you can go into them. There are conveyor belts connnecting everything and they lead you clockwise or toward the center. *Top-left quadrant: Plate, two Steamers and the Sink, entrance towards the center, on the left. *Top-right quadrant: Three Chopping Boards, Plate and Fire Extinguisher, entranced centered at the top and facing towards the outer ring. *Bottom-left quadrant: Ingredient Boxes for Beef, Fish, Prawn and Flour, entrance towards the center, on the right. *Bottom-right quadrant: Two Mixers, Plate Return, Trash Bin and Carrot Ingredient Box, entrance facing right. The Service Counter is on the very left.

levels.title: Kevin 7
levels.overview: The kitchen is split into top and bottom halves, with a moving platform on each side. The left moving platform contains both Mixers and the Carrot Ingredient Box, while the right one contains both Steamers and the Fish Ingredient Box. The top half contains the Plate Return, the Trash Bin, Ingredient Boxes for Beef and Flour, a plate and two Chopping Boards. Meanwhile, the bottom half has the Sink, two Chopping Boards, two Plates and the Ingredient Box for Prawn. The halves have one Countertop in the dead center connecting them.

levels.title: Kevin 8
levels.overview:
The kitchen is split apart by a fast tile-type Conveyor Belt that gets supplied by 5 Ingredient Dispensers (from left to right, they dispense Beef, Prawn, Flour, Carrots and Fish), then conjoins from 5 to 1, and then splits from a rotating part of the conveyor belt into 3, each leading to Trash Bins. Each side has a Chopping Board and two plates, one of the plates is surrounded by Mixers/Steamers.
The right side has the mixers, the left side the steamers. The left side also has the Fire Extinguisher and the Sink in the top left, and the right side has the Serving Counter and the Plate Return.

levels.title: The Peckening
levels.game_field: Overcooked!, Overcooked: All You Can Eat
levels.overview: The kitchen is set up on two buildings opposite of each other, with a platform held by Kevin's Helicopter serving as a way across the two. The left side of the kitchen is shaped like the letter E, having two Burners, two Pots, two Pans, a Trash Bin in the middle, an Oven and the Fire Extinguisher, while the bottom half holds a Deep Fryer and a Frying Basket. The right side has tight corridors formed like a 3 that has two additional sections inbetween. The places of the Oven and the Deep Fryer are the same, but instead of the Trash Bin being in the middle, it is placed in the upper-right corner, and there is a Chopping Board and the Sink in the middle. The Ever Peckish is placed on the right side of the kitchen, serving the purpose of a Service Counter. Below him is the Plate Return, which holds 3 Dirty Plates. This makes The Peckening the only kitchen in Overcooked! that has Dirty Dishes at its start. Meteors fall upon the kitchen, making Countertops burst with fire when they hit. This kitchen has multiple phases with different recipes, which are described below. Once the chefs deliver the final Order of a phase to the Ever Peckish, the next phase begins. If it is the last phase, the kitchen is won. Additionally, in Overcooked: All You Can Eat, the level can be beaten in different amounts of stars based on the Tip Combo mechanic. br
